subject: QBR prep: stakeholder action orchestrator & exception triage
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: cto@acme.com, procurement@bigco.com
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: stakeholder action orchestrator & exception triage

Team — kicking off the QBR prep thread for the cross-functional items that rolled out of yesterday's sync. I tried to keep this tactical: owners, clear asks, and what needs exec attention. Please read and update by EOD Tuesday so I can finalize the exec slide pack.

Top-level asks (exec scope) — ACTIONS REQUIRED
1) SLA exception for customer "Acme Corp" for Dedicated burst capacity (ask: 99.9 -> 99.95) — owner: aditya_rao — input due: 2028-06-02
2) One-off credits request for Acme POC overage (ask: ~$12k) — owner: lauren_bishop — decision for exec: yes/no by 2028-06-03
3) SOC2 evidence packet for procurement review (Acme & BigCo) — owner: marissa_cole — deliverable: SOC2_request_answers.docx (attached) by 2028-06-02

Operational follow-ups (xfn owners)
- Model rollout caveat (memory regression on long contexts) — owner: karthik_iyer — mitigation: canary longer KV-cache window; timeline: 3 working days
- Eval regression alert: flagged prompt-set "Billing-E2E-01" — owner: marissa_cole — action: run additional A/B with q3 quant profile
- Docs: update runbooks and rollback playbook link (Drive) — owner: irene_choi — link below

Attached: QBR_exec_asks_v2.xlsx (updated asks + proposed slide bullets), SOC2_request_answers.docx
Drive tracker: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_qbr_exec_tracker
Jira: JIRA-4521 (exception: dedicated-burst)

Please reply with one-line confirmations + any blocking constraints. If you need me to escalate an item to Aditya/executive office, mark with [ESC].

Thanks — I'll collate and push the final slide draft Wednesday morning.

—
Irene Choi
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

On Fri, Jun 1, 2028 at 09:15 Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — kicking off the QBR prep thread for the cross-functional items that rolled out of yesterday's sync. I tried to keep this tactical: owners, clear asks, and what needs exec attention. Please read and update by EOD Tuesday so I can finalize the exec slide pack.

Thanks, Irene — confirming owners and one quick technical note. For the model rollout caveat: I will implement the longer KV-cache window as a canary on the dedicated pool (non-prod first). That mitigation should remove the regression for sequences under 8k tokens; I'll post metrics to the Drive tracker by EOD Monday.

Owner confirmations: karthik -> model mitigation; marissa -> SOC2 + eval; lauren -> credits decision; aditya -> SLA exception (will coordinate with legal/procurement).

Blocking ask for me: access to the dedicated canary pool (ticketed to infra). If infra isn't green by Monday morning I'll request an exec exception to expedite.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: cto@acme.com
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: stakeholder action orchestrator & exception triage

Irene / all — attaching a snapshot of the exception log (exception_log_snapshot.pdf). Quick notes:
- The billing regression flagged under Billing-E2E-01 looks tied to the quant profile change we rolled last week; I'm running a targeted A/B now and will have preliminary stats by EOD Monday.
- SOC2 packet: I've filled the access-control and incident response sections in SOC2_request_answers.docx. Still need input from Security on encryption-at-rest specifics (cc'd separately to security team).
- Credits: Lauren — I've put suggested thresholds in the attached QBR_exec_asks_v2.xlsx sheet (tab: credits-recommendations). If you want a conservative stance for exec, flag "recommendation: partial-credit (50%)".

Attach: exception_log_snapshot.pdf
Link to updated tracker (comments added): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_qbr_exec_tracker

Marissa
Sr PM, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Quick note — flagging [ESC] on the SLA exception if infra cannot guarantee the canary window change by EOD Monday. I agree we should be conservative on credits unless the billing A/B shows clear repeatable overcharge; Marissa, appreciate the thresholds.

Procurement: procurement@bigco.com, please confirm whether the SOC2 packet we are assembling aligns with your evidence requirements so we can avoid rework during review.

I'll loop in Legal on the SLA language tomorrow morning (they requested a short lead for commit windows).

—Aditya
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: cto@acme.com, procurement@bigco.com, d.smith@consultingfirm.com
Date: Sun, 03 Jun 2028 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: stakeholder action orchestrator & exception triage

Thanks all — good progress. Short roll-up and next steps (I'm capturing these in the Drive slide draft):
- Karthik: proceed with canary for KV-cache window; post metrics to Drive by Mon EOD. If infra blocks, reply with [ESC] and I'll escalate to Aditya. (JIRA-4521)
- Marissa: finalize SOC2_request_answers.docx sections and attach any outstanding logs; we will not send to procurement until Security signs off.
- Lauren: recommend you take the partial-credit recommendation into the exec ask as "preferred ask: 50% credit; fallback: 25%". Need your confirmation by Mon 11:00 PT.
- Aditya: please prepare the SLA language redline and loop Legal; mark if you need exec bandwidth for a fast-track.

I've attached an updated QBR_exec_asks_v2.xlsx with a one-page slide draft (tab: slide-bullet) and exception_log_snapshot.pdf for reference.

Final: I'll lock slides Wednesday 08:00 PT and send to exec distribution. If anything blocks that timeline, put [BLOCK] in the Drive tracker or reply here.

Thanks — Irene
—
Irene Choi
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
